name: ModuleDock

localizedDescriptions.zh: 本地模块更新器：支持 Surge 模块、Loon 插件、Stash 覆写与 Shadowrocket 模块，批量更新 #SUBSCRIBED、从链接安装并自动识别目标，同时把 scriptable:// 跳转到 scripting://。

description: Local module updater for Surge, Loon, Stash and Shadowrocket: batch-update #SUBSCRIBED modules, install from URL with automatic target detection, and redirect scriptable:// links to scripting:// with four companion modules plus a built-in Safari browser script.
